steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Surrender now!
A crack of thunder knocks the girl's blade out of her hands and sends her to the ground.
Dark clouds hover above her head, ready to deliver an even more powerful thunderclap.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I suggest you don't move, unless you wish to be struck by lightning.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Persistent lot, aren't you, Master Lin and Candleholder Zuo?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: A peaceful end, and no harm was done. Do you really need to prosecute me so?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: All the people you dragged into this 'show' of yours...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It is no mean feat, summoning a Sui-Xiang with the token of a Feranmut proxy.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Who are you? Where did you learn such forbidden arts?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Is that all you care about?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: The most ancient secret in this land is within reach, Candleholder, and all you want to do is to arrest everyone who tries to understand it?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Objects have masters, but knowledge has none. Who decided that the Sui Regulator, and no one else, is allowed to know?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How am I supposed to believe that you have no malicious intent, given what you did at Mangshan Town?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You'll come with us, and you'll paint a clear picture of everything you know, and everything you're planning.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: So you want to take me alive. Does that mean there's nothing you can do, should I insist on running?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Obstinate fool...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: We want you alive, but not necessarily conscious—
One moment!
A crack echoes in the sky, but the fire is faster.
The blade of flame cuts through the thunder, and a figure lands in front of the Liberi.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Your Lei Fa is quite impressive for your age.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Your Arts are familiar. Does Bai Dingshan's generation have their own students now?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: These fire Arts...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Could you be—Zushi?!

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: (Isn't this the girl who played with Grain Buds in Dahuang?)

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I... I am Lin Qingyan, student of the Lei Fa school, and of the Tianshi Bureau.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: This isn't a formal occasion. No need for formalities.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You too, girl.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: ...Mo Yi of the Shanhaizhong. Greetings, Tianshi.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (So she's really Shanhaizhong.)

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Why the look of surprise? Go to the scrolls in the deepest sections of your library. You are the ones who are behind in terms of Feranmut research.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: All I see is the Shanhaizhong committing evil deeds of every kind in the name of the Feranmuts.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: What have I to do with those who commit murder, arson, or any other deeds under the Shanhaizhong name? How is it any of my business?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: Can you guarantee that everyone who wears that shiny uniform of yours is an upstanding individual?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You—

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: These eccentric ways, this sharp tongue of yours... you're just like your founder.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: I thought the old carpenter didn't have any heirs left, after all these years. Looks like I was wrong.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: The great hunt a thousand years ago contradicted his ideals. He became disillusioned and shied away from society...

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: But some people remember how he wanted to stop the war.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You talk big. How do you intend to stop this war?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: I simply wanted to see the master of the Garden of Grotesqueries. It was for this reason that I stole the Book of Kung Fu and summoned the Sui-Xiang.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: I guarantee that this war can be stopped, if I'm allowed to enter his garden to find a certain object.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: ...A remnant of the proxy who disappeared.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You have nerve, if nothing else...

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Round-head!

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You've been listening long enough. Are you going to welcome your guests or not?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: All the guests present today are very important...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You certainly made my heart skip a beat with your suggestion... Or you would, if I had one...

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Enough small talk. This has more to do with you than anyone else. What do you plan on doing?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I spoke with my master just now... since both you and a Candleholder of the Sui Regulator are here, may I make a proposal...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: May we have our guests assist in the Placation for this year, as it seems fate has intended?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Placation?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The Sui Regulator checks on the slumbering bestial Sui and reinforces the seal on the Tomb of Sui. This process is called the Placation.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But it has always been the most experienced Candleholders who handle the affair...

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: The rogue proxy entered the Tomb of Sui several days ago. There has been no news since. The Sui Regulator is likely vexed about to how to conduct this year's Placation.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: This is a major matter. I must report to—

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You really think there's time to make a report?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Just go on. If the Grand Tutor asks, tell him I gave the nod.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: U-Understood...

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You, girl, you're coming with me.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You don't get along with that Candleholder kid, and you'll just keep fighting in there. Whatever you're looking for, he can look for it for you.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: As for you, I want to talk to you about that master of yours.

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: ...As you wish.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: What should we do?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: It's not hard. Just go up along the path once you enter the Garden of Grotesqueries, and pay attention to your surroundings.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Other than that, be careful of collections in the Garden of Grotesqueries... the geists of the master's collection are a far cry from those you saw in the town. You must be careful.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: You said go up? But we're already at the top of the mountain, aren't we?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Where is this 'Garden of Grotesqueries' that you speak of?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Infinitely far, and infinitely close... when you are on this mountain, you are adjacent to the Garden of Grotesqueries.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Taking you into the Garden of Grotesqueries is easy, but reach its depths requires the touch of fate—may I borrow the weiqi board that you carry with you?

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Of course... go ahead.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: And may I have the tome you are carrying, young lady?

steps.name: Mo Yi
steps.text: ...Whatever.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: A passage will now be opened. Go through this passage, and you may enter the forbidden grounds of the Garden of Grotesqueries.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Lines of war, warp and weft, in the order of heaven and earth—

The weiqi board and book extend infinitely into the distance from Liang's hands, creating a realm within a realm. Mountains turn to flatland in the blink of an eye, and the group goes through this strange space—
They step out of it to find a door hidden behind a screen.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Welcome to the Garden of Grotesqueries.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: This was a town full of vitality before that disaster, with hundreds of households and flourishing farmland...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Many years have passed, and now all that is left is—

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Come out.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Mysterious Entity
steps.text: Yes, Master Liang.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Are all of you here?

steps.name: Mysterious Entity
steps.text: (Looks left and right)

steps.name: Strange Entity
steps.text: There are some broken tiles and bricks amidst the ruins. Not much time has passed since they awakened, and they do not yet understand language... should they be brought out?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Let me explain why I'm here first.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: All of you must leave this place.

steps.name: Strange Entity
steps.text: (Whispering to one another)

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Everyone who lived here has either died or departed after that incident at the Tomb of Sui.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You are mundane artifacts that have gained sentience from the incident's aftermath, wandering this place...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Perhaps you've already sensed the presence of a garden above the tomb, which Yi calls the Garden of Grotesqueries.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Neither Yan nor the siblings will tolerate the presence of a geist-infested ruin in the vicinity of the Garden of Grotesqueries.

steps.name: Mysterious Entity
steps.text: We understand.

steps.name: Strange Entity
steps.text: But where can we go, Master Liang?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Yi said those of good form or quality can find a home in the garden. The rest must be cleaned up.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You have one month to prepare. All traces of the disaster should be gone by then.

steps.name: Mysterious Entity
steps.text: The east area has been cleaned up.

steps.name: Mysterious Entity
steps.text: We'll sow some grass seeds here, then clean up the west area. It used to be a river that flowed through the town, but it'll take some time to clean up the sludge.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Good work.

steps.name: Strange Entity
steps.text: We've gathered the geists that meet the requirements, with reference to the book that you brought... they're all here. There aren't many.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Go and help them, then come with me to the Garden of Grotesqueries afterwards.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: It's busy here.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: Where is Yi?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: He went out.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: He found the surroundings of one of the pavilions a little too sparse, and went looking for something to decorate there.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: It seems like you're the only one around, whenever I visit.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: That's why he built me.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: He can be quite communicative... to people and things that he's interested in.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: He would talk three days and nights to a child just to obtain a stone, even if scolded and abused, but he can't stand to be around your kind for even a few minutes.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: That's for the best, I suppose. I couldn't stand his fake hospitality either.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: Back on topic. Are things not proceeding a little slow? Seven days have passed, and only a small part of the ruins has been cleared.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Slow?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Clearing the rubble is the easy part. But properly handling hundreds if not thousands of objects touched by geisthood... I'm sure the Sui Regulator knows full well how arduous a task it is.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: There's an easier way, no?

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: If my ears didn't deceive me, some Waregeists are following you back to the Garden of Grotesqueries...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Do you mean that I should take all the geist-touched objects, bricks and tiles, weeds and branches, chairs and tables, cups and plates... back to the Garden of Grotesqueries?

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: We don't have the space.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: Didn't you say that Yi thought the garden was a little sparse?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Did I?

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: The awakening of Sui caused great upheaval in Baizao and the surrounding lands. Your siblings have paid a dear price, even...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Stop.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Yi says that is all in the past. The siblings do not wish to speak of it, especially not with you.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: In any event, the affairs of the Garden of Grotesqueries have always been the affairs of the people.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: It sits atop the tomb, pinning the slumbering one in a dream, pacifying the evil that would threaten Baizao...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I think you're mistaken about something.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: The Garden of Grotesqueries is first and foremost Yi's garden.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Home to the rare and delightful, the eccentric and the grotesque from all four corners, from ancient times to present, Yi would love to have the sights of the whole world in its boundaries, and would gladly move the entire garden's layout for the sake of one little rock...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: It is not a tool for the Sui Regulator, and certainly not a trash heap for the Tomb of Sui.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I will deal with the geists near the tomb. The Sui Regulator should not presume to interfere with anything else.

steps.name: Sui Regulator Visitor
steps.text: Hasn't the east side been cleaned up? Why is this Waregeist going that way?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Someone's coming. Stay out of sight.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: This is it, this is the place...

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: At long last...

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Oh, sorry, I didn't realize there was somebody here... er, y-you're human, right?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Nothing you need to worry about.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Well, er... sir? Are you one of the mandarins assigned to watch these hills, judging by your attire?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You could say that.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: This place has long been abandoned, the roads broken and overgrown. No civilian has approached it in many years. Who are you?

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: You might know there was once a town here. I used to live here.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: It was a long time ago.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: A disaster happened many years ago, a terrible event that no one could truly describe. The town was destroyed overnight...

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: I was a young boy at the time. My whole family was... it was by sheer luck that I survived.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: I went to Jiangqi and lived there for many years. This is the first time I've been back.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Jiangqi is a long way from here.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: A very long way.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: I spent most of the money that I saved over the years on this journey.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Just to see these... ruins?

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: No, I plan to rest for a couple of days, then get about fixing this house and clearing some farmland around here.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: I think my journey has come to an end.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I don't understand. You've found a new life in Jiangqi. Why are you obsessed with these broken ruins?

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: They may look like ruins to you, broken beams and cracked bricks overgrown with weeds...

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: But after all these years, I still remember how I hid my pocket money in a corner of the house, to buy sweets from a passing peddler...

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: I remember fighting with the neighbor's kid, bringing lunch to our parents in the fields together, going to class at the school on the west side together...

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: This is my home, sir, even if it was destroyed.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: As you say, it was destroyed.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You remember the disaster. Aren't you afraid it may strike again?

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Catastrophe is everywhere on this land. There is no haven that has never been touched by disaster.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Disaster might interrupt our lives, but we'll come back after it's gone. We'll fix the houses, clean up the fields, again and again... as it always has been, for centuries and more.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: I met others who fled this place before I set out on the journey. They want to come back, just like me. Before long...

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Given enough time, even objects form an attachment to a place, never mind humans.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: But you can't stay here... at least, not for a few days yet.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: There are official restrictions in place for this area right now. Go and stay at a nearby inn and wait for the announcement.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Ouch—did I trip over something?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: It's nothing. I'll see you off.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Come out.
Silence.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I suggest you come out while I'm still asking politely.
There is rustling in a corner, and a Waregeist in the shape of a bottle emerges from its hiding place after a while.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: ...It was you.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You were the one who was running around when the Sui Regulator came, weren't you?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: This place has been cleaned up. Why are you hiding here?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You don't want to be destroyed?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: (Shakes up and down)

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Do you want to come with me to the Garden of Grotesqueries?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: (Shakes left and right)

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You want to stay here?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: (Shakes up and down)

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: I'm waiting for someone, sir.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Waiting for someone?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: The ones who made me.

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: A scholar by the name of Lan Ke and a woman by the name of Bai Jin made me, when this place was still a town. They said I was the first thing they made for their new home.

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: When they got married, they put me in the most prominent place in the living room and put a new flower in me every day. Never forget.

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: They shaped me and put me in the furnace, then went off to do other things while I was being heated...

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: Then the disaster happened, and they never came back.

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: I... I've been waiting for them...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You're not going anywhere?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: I'm not going anywhere.
Sir...

steps.name: Scroll-Shaped Entity
steps.text: Please don't be angry at it, sir.
The scroll-shaped entity stands before Liang and angles its upper half forward, its bamboo strips turning white at the effort.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Are you... bowing?

steps.name: Scroll-Shaped Entity
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Scroll-Shaped Entity
steps.text: I learned that one should bow politely when making a request.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Scroll-Shaped Entity
steps.text: There used to be a school on the west side of town, and I laid on the top layer of the bookshelf.

steps.name: Scroll-Shaped Entity
steps.text: The teacher told the students, 'Manners maketh man.' He said it many times, and I remembered.

steps.name: Scroll-Shaped Entity
steps.text: It didn't mean to disobey your orders, but it has had no other thought in its mind for so many years.

steps.name: Scroll-Shaped Entity
steps.text: Could you, perhaps, oblige it?
The scroll-shaped entity once again bows.
I won't let you hurt it, no matter your answer!
A sword-shaped entity puts itself in front of the bottle-shaped entity and scroll-shaped entity, pointing its head, the tip of the sword, towards Liang. Its blade reflects the sunlight.

steps.name: Sword-Shaped Entity
steps.text: It's my... my...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Kindred? Friend?

steps.name: Sword-Shaped Entity
steps.text: Yeah, that.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I have a few questions for you, bottle.

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: When did you start thinking that way?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: ...I don't remember.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Have you ever doubted?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: Why should I doubt?

steps.name: Bottle-Shaped Entity
steps.text: That man from Jiangqi came back. So will Lan Ke and Bai Jin.
Liang stands in silence, as the wind blows through his hollow skull and chest mechanism, causing a soft humming sound.
He looks like he is thinking.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I thought the contamination had caused you to form basic sentience, no more than that.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You wander around this place, your words and actions limited by your attributes as objects...

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Little did I imagine that you would develop human-level thoughts and emotions...

steps.name: Returned Traveler
steps.text: Given enough time, even objects form an attachment to a place, never mind humans.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Interesting.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You are Waregeists that have lingered after the disaster. Do you remember what the town looked like?

steps.name: Waregeists
steps.text: We do, sir.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Can you restore it?

steps.name: Waregeists
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Are you willing to live together with humans?

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: What have you been doing behind my back, Liang?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: I told you to clean up the ruins, destroy the Waregeists that should be destroyed, and bring back the Waregeists that should be brought back to the Garden of Grotesqueries...

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: But you built a town?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You're talking like you don't know.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I'm your creation. My thoughts are your thoughts. My deeds are your deeds.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Hah. I see, I see.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Besides, this is the best solution, isn't it?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: There are too many geist-touched objects around the Tomb of Sui. Simply destroying them or throwing them into the garden won't solve the problem.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: People are returning to this town, long after it was turned to ruins...

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Your account of the changes in the geists is interesting.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: But the Sui Regulator must have complained about letting geists live together with people. What did you say to them?

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I told them we'll keep an eye.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: 'Yi and I, just the two of us, are going to have a hard time watching over all the geists, if all we have is a single garden.'

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: 'What if the geists get out? It would be like what happened to Mangshan Town: The Sui Regulator would take the brunt of it, then Baizao.'

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Haha, good.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: I never have to worry, with you in charge.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Xiexie.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Anyway, it's a good thing.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: A town in the proximity of the Garden of Grotesqueries will delay those with ill intent, giving us time to welcome our guests.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Now, clean the garden, and let us welcome our visitors.
